requirement.description: The FindInMap class constructor does not support the 'defaultvalue' parameter, but tests expect it to be supported. The constructor only accepts mapname, toplevelkey, and secondlevelkey parameters.
requirement.contract: The FindInMap.__init__ method should accept an optional 'defaultvalue' parameter that gets added to the Fn::FindInMap function call as a DefaultValue field in the array.

requirement.description: The BaseAWSObject.__eq__ method compares objects using to_json() which can cause comparison failures for complex objects. The test expects comparison with a TypeComparator object but fails due to serialization differences.
requirement.contract: The BaseAWSObject.__eq__ method should be enhanced to properly compare with TypeComparator objects by checking the type compatibility instead of relying solely on to_json serialization.

requirement.description: The Template.__eq__ method uses to_json() for comparison which can lead to inconsistent behavior when comparing templates with identical content but different serialization orders.
requirement.contract: The Template.__eq__ method should implement a more robust comparison that doesn't rely on JSON serialization order, comparing the actual structure instead.

requirement.description: The validate_dbinstance function has incorrect error messages. It reports "Either (MasterUsername and MasterUserPassword) or DBSnapshotIdentifier are required" but tests expect "Either (MasterUsername and either MasterUserPassword or ManageMasterUserPassword) or DBSnapshotIdentifier are required".
requirement.contract: The validate_dbinstance function should be updated to check for ManageMasterUserPassword along with MasterUserPassword when validating the credentials requirement for RDS instances.

requirement.description: The SecurityGroup class (imported in test_basic.py) does not implement a __hash__ method, causing TypeError when trying to hash a SecurityGroup object.
requirement.contract: The SecurityGroup class should implement a __hash__ method to make it hashable, allowing it to be used in sets and as dictionary keys.
